nationals.source: Whole population is the base (no national/expat split relevant)

population.base_note: Hemoglobinopathies cluster in Afro-Colombian populations of the Pacific and Caribbean coasts (mostly HbS). Thalassemia is predominantly trait/minor of Mediterranean origin in the Andean region; beta-thalassemia major is rare.

pharma_market_usd.source: Market reports ~USD 5-6bn; used only for the budget-impact ceiling

health_system.summary: Near-universal insurance (SGSSS) through EPS insurers in contributory and subsidized regimes, financed by ADRES. Orphan-disease drugs outside the benefit plan were funded through 'presupuestos maximos' (2020-2025) and are moving to centralized purchase (Resolution 542 of 2025). The system is in a liquidity crisis: EPS debts reached COP 58 trillion in 2025 (+26.5% y/y) and debts to drug suppliers COP 3.8 trillion (+33%); several large EPS are under government intervention.
sources: Consultorsalud, Colombia apuesta por la compra centralizada de medicamentos para enfermedades huerfanas (Res. 542/2025), https://consultorsalud.com/?p=311748
Asi Vamos en Salud via Consultorsalud, deficit en presupuestos maximos 50-55% for 2025, https://consultorsalud.com/deficit-presupuestos-maximos-medicamentos/

Bloomberg Linea, Deuda de las EPS llego a COP 58 billones en 2025, https://www.bloomberglinea.com/latinoamerica/colombia/deuda-de-las-eps-en-colombia-llego-a-cop58-billones-en-2025-un-alza-de-265-en-un-ano/
Vanguardia, Crisis en la Nueva EPS: pacientes con enfermedades huerfanas en riesgo (Oct 2025)

regulatory.pathway: Full sanitary registration (registro sanitario); no formal reliance clock for FDA/EMA-approved molecules

typical_review_months.source: AFIDRO/AmCham/FIFARMA roadmap: new-registration approvals 22 months (2024) -> 29 months (2025); ANDI cites 18-24 months at end-2024, https://consultorsalud.com/modernizacion-del-invima-afidro-amcham-fifarma/

p_approval_given_fda_ema.source: Same roadmap: ~50% of orphan-disease new-molecule applications denied in 2025 (industry figure); FDA/EMA-approved product with phase 3 data assumed better than average

pricing.authority: Comision Nacional de Precios de Medicamentos y Dispositivos Medicos (CNPMDM)

months_to_price_after_approval.source: Price can be sold free on registration; direct control (precio maximo) follows via the next Circular once the product is in a concentrated 'mercado relevante'

reprice_cut.source: Annual price updates under Circular 19/2024 methodology; COP devaluation handled separately

pricing.notes: Circular 03 de 2013 (art. 9): per-country simple averages, outliers removed, the 25th percentile is the international reference price (PRI). Circular 18 de 2024 (Diario Oficial 52.697, 13-Mar-2024) replaced it: adds a national reference price (PRN, P90 of SISMED prices when 2+ suppliers) and a Bancolombia case study describes the base as min(P20 international, national average). For a single-supplier orphan product the PRN does not exist, so the international percentile governs. P25 is used as base; P20 in sensitivity. The newest, cheapest source per country is preferred.
sources: Consultorsalud, Instauran regimen de control de precios - Circular 18 de 2024, https://consultorsalud.com/instauran-regimen-de-control-de-precios-a-medicamentos-circular-18-de-2024/
Bancolombia, Estrategias de precios de medicamentos en Colombia, https://www.bancolombia.com/empresas/capital-inteligente/actualidad-economica-sectorial/estrategias-precios-medicamentos-colombia

payers.name: Contributory regime EPS, orphan drug funded via ADRES (presupuestos maximos / centralized purchase)
payers.note: MIPRES prescription is immediate after registration, but payment depends on ADRES transfers that were 50-55% short in 2025

payers.name: Subsidized regime EPS (same funding route, weaker insurers)
payers.note: Nueva EPS and other intervened insurers concentrate here

early_access_share.source: Import of an unregistered orphan drug as 'medicamento vital no disponible' is possible but rare and litigation-driven (tutelas); a handful of patients at most.
early_access_share.note: Share of label-eligible patients treated through early access (named-patient / hospital budget) before any payer listing; paid at list price.

budget_ceiling_share_of_pharma_market.source: Orphan budget under acute strain; a new product above ~0.3% of drug spend would be rationed

disease_prevalence_per_1000_adults.source: No national figure exists: 'la ausencia de un programa nacional de tamizaje no permite determinar su prevalencia' (Archivos de Medicina 2019, https://www.redalyc.org/journal/2738/273859249013/273859249013.pdf). Regional studies (Cartagena, Buenaventura, Cali, San Andres, Bogota 2009-2020) find thalassemia mostly as trait. Central case = ~200 adults with beta-thalassemia major/intermedia nationally, bounded by the 88,426-person national orphan registry (June 2024).
disease_prevalence_per_1000_adults.note: This is the single weakest input in the Colombia case and is flagged in sensitivity

diagnosed_share.source: No newborn or premarital hemoglobinopathy screening; diagnosis is clinical

in_specialist_care_share.source: Orphan-disease law (Ley 1392/2010) and mandatory notification (Sivigila event 342) route diagnosed patients to care

label_eligible_share.source: Adults with TDT or NTDT Hb <=10 g/dL

soc_annual_cost_usd.source: Transfusion + generic deferasirox at Colombian prices

disease_prevalence_per_1000_adults.source: Afro-Colombians ~10% of population; SCD incidence ~1% in Afro-descendant population (Novartis Colombia); ~4,000-8,000 patients nationally is the range quoted by patient groups. Not verified against Sivigila counts.

label_eligible_share.source: Adults with symptomatic anemia; pending label

competition_weights.note: Price weight doubled vs Saudi Arabia: cash-constrained payer; IETS cost-effectiveness culture
